create_Spot_client: create a Spot robot client that authenticates and connects to the robot using environment variables
get_image_responses: retrieve images from Spot cameras by specifying sources, quality, and pixel format parameters
get_hand_image: get hand camera RGB and depth images, automatically switching between gripper and Intel RealSense cameras
convert_image_response_to_cv2: convert a Bosdyn image response object into an OpenCV numpy array with optional reorientation
use_SpotCamIds: use SpotCamIds constants to reference camera sources like hand color, Intel RealSense RGB, and depth
